vietstock.title: "Greenwashing" from the perspective of an international ESG consultant
vietstock.quote: Recently, we have been testing an application called GreenPulse.AI. This is an artificial intelligence (AI) assistant that helps SMEs in Vietnam and Southeast Asia easily practice sustainability. Users will be guided step-by-step to solve issues such as reducing electricity costs, meeting export requirements, with a dashboard to track progress. The platform also integrates automatic ESG reporting tools according to international standards. The main purpose is to help businesses avoid the 'greenwashing' trap, demonstrate measurable improvements, and expand access to investors, customers and international markets.

questions.question: How is GreenPulse different from ChatGPT or other general AI tools?
questions.answer: GreenPulse is purpose-built for ESG compliance and sustainability reporting. Unlike ChatGPT, we're trained on international frameworks (GRI, SFDR, CSRD, ISSB) and integrate with your existing data sources (ERP, CRM, Excel). We provide structured outputs that meet regulatory requirements—not generic text that needs manual review.

questions.question: Is my data secure? Do you share it with third parties?
questions.answer: **FREE PLAN:** Your conversations use third-party AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic). Data is transmitted to their servers (US-based) for processing. These providers may use conversation data for model improvement unless opted-out. **PREMIUM & GOLDEN PLANS:** We offer locally-hosted AI models (Llama 3) deployed in Southeast Asia. Your data never leaves our infrastructure—ensuring full data sovereignty, zero third-party sharing, and compliance with local data residency requirements. All data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest (AES-256).

questions.question: Doesn't AI generate emissions? How do you manage this?
questions.answer: Yes, AI computing does generate emissions—which is why we offset 200% of our carbon footprint through verified carbon removal projects. More importantly, GreenPulse's automation reduces the need for travel, paper reports, and redundant manual work, resulting in a net-negative carbon impact for our users.

questions.question: Can GreenPulse integrate with our existing tools?
questions.answer: Absolutely. GreenPulse connects with major ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data sources (Excel, Google Sheets, CSV). Our API allows custom integrations for proprietary systems. Most implementations are live within 2 weeks.

questions.question: What if GreenPulse makes a mistake in compliance reporting?
questions.answer: GreenPulse provides transparency in all outputs—showing which frameworks and data points inform each recommendation. All reports include human-in-the-loop review checkpoints before finalization. We also offer audit trails and version control to ensure regulatory confidence.
